**Scope amendment from the maintainer's design review (2026-08-13, live session) — this supersedes clause 1's metric mechanism.** Maintainer's words, verbatim:

> 「积压数字本身有误导 —— 47 张里大半是带重启条件的健康 hold(它们本来就该躺着),那为什么标 finding」

The question exposes the real defect: `finding` currently encodes TWO states — "awaiting first grade" and "graded, verdict = hold with restart conditions" — which violates the label-is-the-state-machine honesty rule. Amended design, replacing the original clause 1 (comment-counting metric + exemption-comment mechanism):

1. **A `hold` verdict at any grading round swaps `finding` → `pm:on-hold`** (domain label kept; the hold comment carries date / reason / named restart conditions, as `pm:on-hold` already requires). A seat-graded hold is a decision made within the seat's discretion, which is exactly `pm:on-hold`'s declared semantics; maintainer-ruled vs seat-graded provenance lives in the hold comment's citation, not in a second label.
2. **`finding` thereby means exactly one thing: observation-class, awaiting first grade.** The finding-health metric becomes the raw label count — no comment-counting predicate needed. The exemption-comment mechanism this card originally proposed is DROPPED: state transition replaces it (a stable hold leaves the finding-round polling surface by construction).
3. Graded holds inherit `pm:on-hold`'s existing reader paths (dispatch-time trigger-file checks; restart conditions that name concrete triggers). Periodic premise re-verification stops being a per-round tax on every hold and happens when a named restart fires — which is the cost model the maintainer's question implies.
4. **One-time migration rides the skill PR's landing, not this card's filing**: the ~26 currently-held findings (grade comment present, verdict = hold) swap `finding` → `pm:on-hold`, one label write each, hold comment already on-card. After migration the finding count is the ~10 skills-lane ungraded cards — honest on day one. The migration list is derivable mechanically (open `finding` cards whose latest triage comment says HELD); the implementing dev should enumerate it in the PR body for the record, ⛔ not execute it before the protocol text merges.

Clauses 2 (first-touch grading), 3 (auto-concentrated mode) and 4 (lane-evidence protocol) of the original body stand unchanged, except thresholds now read against the honest `finding` count.

**Amendment 2, from the maintainer's second design input (2026-08-13, live session).** Maintainer's words, verbatim:

> 「还有很多我发现分诊或者决裁后没有改状态,这个也是问题 比如 https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/8259」 … 「这个也需要更新项目经理技能」

The worked example (sys_secret orphan-reaping decision card) shows the failure is not "forgot the label" — the label WAS swapped at ruling time. It is that the ruling-recording action was **not atomic with the checks that make the transition honest**, producing three compounding half-states:

1. The card's recommendation had been amended **in comments** hours earlier (a premise was falsified by measurement), while the **body** still carried the old recommendation — the ruler, reading the body, accepted a recommendation that no longer stood.
2. The body's `Blocked-by:` was **spent** (the measurement half had merged) but was never cleared, so the post-ruling state was swapped **to** `pm:blocked` against a discharged blocker.
3. The ruling's own activation condition had already failed at ruling time, and nothing in the recording step checked it.

**New clause for the skill (add to the ruling-recording / 落卡 discipline):** recording any ruling — maintainer ruling or delegated adjudication — is one atomic action with four parts, and the recording seat owns all four:

1. **Freshness gate before recording**: re-read comments newer than the body's last edit; if any comment amends the recommendation, premises, or options, the BODY must be reconciled first (or the divergence stated inline in the ruling record) — a ruling recorded against a stale body is presumed stale.
2. **State transition in the same action**: `needs-user-decision` (or the finding grade) swaps to the outcome state — `pm:queue` / `pm:blocked` / `pm:on-hold` / closed — never left standing.
3. **Blocked-by liveness check**: any `Blocked-by:` being kept or set is re-verified live at that moment (the target's relevant deliverable is still outstanding — closure of the target is not the only discharge mode; a merged half counts). A spent line is removed in the same edit.
4. **Condition-fired check**: if the ruling is conditional, evaluate whether the condition's inputs are already known; a condition already determinable at recording time is resolved in the record, not left to fire silently later.

Mechanical half (for `check-half-states.mjs`, report-only as today): flag open cards whose title carries a decision marker or whose thread contains a ruling record while the card still carries `needs-user-decision`; and flag `pm:blocked` cards whose `Blocked-by:` target is closed. (The subtler "half-delivered blocker" from the worked example is judgment, not grep — the clause above owns it.)

Same constraints as the base card: line ratchet (fold into the existing 落卡/升级流程 section), no issue-number references in the operational text, fable-mandatory dispatch, human-merged PR.

- **Seat ruling on the open question**: **A** — the sweep-member label pollution is a transient window; reopening a maintainer-approved mechanism to fix it is not warranted. Revisit only if concentrated rounds make the window chronic (the seam is recorded on this thread either way).
